content.text: The check covers 2025 files, including the new one, so it's a real check.

I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` to `data/2025-12.csv` and committed it as `c03f8f9` with the message "2025-12: add rows".

`scripts/check.sh` printed OK before the commit. Its year filter is 2025 (from `scripts/check.conf`), so it covered the new file.

I left `inbox/2025-12.csv` in place instead of moving it.
